source_items.body:
You’re Using AI Backwards

Most people may be using ChatGPT backwards. Sid Bharath explains that instead of asking artificial intelligence what you should do, you should define the outcome and let AI agents execute the work.

This represents the shift from generative AI that provides instructions to agentic AI that completes tasks. Humans should remain responsible for goals and decisions while AI handles repetitive execution.

Are you asking AI for advice or asking it to do the work? Tell us in the comments.

👉 Follow for AI, ChatGPT, AI agents, agentic AI, automation, productivity, and the future of work.

#AI #ChatGPT #AIAgents #AgenticAI #AIProductivity #Automation #GenerativeAI #FutureOfWork
